If the API LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg has been called with a state other than TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ASSIGNED,  The Service Discovery Module shall leave th e Main Phase and enter the DOWN Phase  All EventHandler which are not in state SD_EVENT _HANDLER_RELEASED shall be set to SD_EVENT_HANDLER_RELEASED and be indicated to the BswM module by calling the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState
